llm_gguf.title: LFM3-Omni-2B-Abliter8 (Q6_K)
llm_gguf.notes: Omni model: understands text, images and audio and replies with text or speech. Q6_K is the card's serving example and keeps a much closer neutral-text distribution than Q4 builds (Q8_0 for maximum fidelity). Needs its mmproj for images and the pinned llama.cpp build (d05706b4b + serving-guide patch), which the popup can compile for you. Filenames are resolved from the repo at download time.

llm_gguf.title: Phi-3 Mini 4K Instruct (Q4_K_M)
llm_gguf.notes: Good default small model. Fast on CPU, very usable on 8GB RAM.

llm_gguf.title: Qwen2.5 3B Instruct (Q4_K_M)
llm_gguf.notes: Great multilingual model. Strong for chat and general tasks at small size.
